capabilities: Render Tekken command notation from tekken code blocks as SVG images
Configure shape size, spacing, text styles, and attack button colors
Test the command syntax in a standalone browser version
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents rendering limits (no power-crush icons, 200-character command limit) and mentions a separate web build for testing syntax in a browser.
problem: Obsidian cannot render fighting-game command notation visually; players must read numeric keypad notation as plain text.
summary: Code-block renderer that converts Tekken fighting-game command notation written in tekken code blocks into SVG images.
